title: Whole transcriptome analysis of HK1EBV exosome-treated fibroblasts.
description: We aimed to investigate whether EBV exosomes will affect gene expression in primary fibroblasts. By obtaining normalized read counts of genes generated from RNA-sequencing, we compared the transcriptomic alterations between fibroblasts treated with HK1EBV exosomes and untreated fibroblasts. Overall design: mRNA profiles of untreated fibroblasts and HK1EBV exosome-treated fibroblasts
